title: Cloudflare 文生图
description: Generate an image with Cloudflare Workers AI (FLUX, SDXL, Lucid, Phoenix). Image-only channel. flux-2 models send multipart bodies and accept one reference image via the image field (each reference must be under 512x512); SDXL models accept one img2img image; flux-schnell has a fixed output size and rejects seed. Keywords: cloudflare workers ai flux sdxl 文生图 image generation

fields.name: steps
fields.title: Steps (sent as steps or num_steps per model; clamped to the model max)

fields.title: Seed (dropped for flux-schnell, whose schema rejects it)
